Lifts are the problem here

A reviewer ( Tenant )

Verified Resident

Halberd Wharf, XW9

Jul 2019

Two lifts for four hundred flats and one of them is always out of service. The concierge
team are kind and the parcel room works, but the wait at eight in the morning is real.
